_comment: Export config for the SwiftPost site-template Gems. Shared by both language
variants; the instruction template is chosen with --instructions.
Run from an agentic-tools checkout sitting beside this repo:
uv run python -m agentic_tools.main.cli export build --target gemini-gem \
This repo cannot run it: its agentic-tools dependency resolves to the legacy
Node CLI, which has skills and policy but no export command.

excludeSkills.ref-sp-dev-docs-authoring: README authoring is not what this assistant is for
excludeSkills.ref-sp-dev-git-commits: the person is not driving git from this chat
excludeSkills.ref-sp-dev-github-actions-ci: CI workflows are out of scope for editing site files
excludeSkills.ref-sp-dev-github-dependabot: dependency automation is out of scope
excludeSkills.ref-sp-dev-package-management: release metadata is out of scope
